Maria (runtime): quick sync: after yesterday's change we're seeing short intermittent tail spikes for a subset of tenants during lane rebalances. not full p99 regressions but 40-120ms spikes for streaming responses.
Devon: yep, saw a few clusters of blips on the dashboard. seems tied to handoff windows.
Maria (runtime): pattern: baseline low latency, then 10-30s of sporadic jitter around handoffs, then back to normal.
Lee: paste a small trace if you have one.
Maria (runtime): here's a distilled trace:
```
[08:12:01] req A routed lane-2
[08:12:01] hot-tenant B moved -> lane-5
[08:12:02] lane-5 batch cut -> kernel swap
[08:12:02] kvcache detach/attach -> short stall ~85ms
[08:12:05] processing resumes
```
Sasha: that detach/attach during kernel transitions is the likely culprit. moving tenants invalidates KV residency and triggers cold touches.
Devon: two mitigation axes: 1) avoid frequent moves of hot tenants, 2) make handoffs nonblocking (anchors/incremental attach).
Lee: we should instrument a handoff_jitter metric: sample latency before/after handoff, add a label for handoff_type. sample rate small (1 in 10) to limit overhead.
Maria (runtime): prototype config I'm testing:
```
handoff_jitter_sampling:
  sample_rate: 0.1
  windows: [3s, 20s]
  emit: traces + histograms
```
Sasha: also classify handoffs: graceful (drain then move) vs forceful (immediate) since impact differs.
Devon: graceful strategy idea: keep a micro-anchor on the old lane until new lane warms KV. anchor = tiny noop that maintains residency.
Lee: anchors consume batch slots though. we need a fairness budget per GPU. maybe a per-GPU anchor token pool.
Maria (runtime): propose "anchor_pool" per GPU: M reserved anchors. anchor ops count toward shaping. tenants draw from their internal anchor budget and are throttled.
Sasha: I'll add a simulator flag --simulate-anchor to model anchors as +1 token and include kernel switch penalty. helps evaluate without changing production.
Devon: I'll run replays: baseline -> anchors -> anchors + smoothing. will post results in #eng-runtime-playback.
Lee: I'll draft PromQL and a dashboard panel: handoff_count, median delta, p90/p95 deltas, anchors_used.
Maria (runtime): eviction rules: if anchor pool exhausted, fallback to immediate move but emit events. adaptive refill: when cluster jitter rises, increase anchor allowance briefly.
Sasha: plus smoothing: delay moves if tenant's short-term latency slope > threshold, delay bounded (e.g., up to N batches).
Devon: tradeoffs: delaying moves increases latency for a moved tenant; anchors consume capacity that could impact others; reserved lanes cost money. default policies should vary by SLA tier.
Maria (runtime): proposed defaults: free tier = immediate moves (no anchors), standard = limited anchors + smoothing, enterprise = reserved lanes / higher anchor budget. document rollout and opt-ins.
Lee: add handoff labels (graceful/forceful/anchor) to traces for easy filtering.
Sasha: starting sampler PR today; will add simulator and labels. aim to land sampling this week.
Devon: queuing replay now. infra-bot: FYI canary rollout 5% -> 25% at 14:00 UTC.
Maria (runtime): keep an eye on handoff_jitter; alert if median delta > 30ms for any high-volume tenant. :eyes:
Devon: noted. thanks all.
